work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief CLXV withdraws the provostship of Capannori (diocese of Lucca) from the pieve of Lunata and erects it into a pieve; LF37319 → LF37326 across own provenance LF37322 and page number 254 LF37325; LF37395 → LF37399 across running title LF37398; complete 6 April 1838 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF37310–37310; the source closing at LF37408–37411 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petruin sub annulo piscatoris die sexta aprilis millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo octavo, pontificatus Nostri anno octavo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
